Contribution to Workshop on "Geoinformation in mobile Applications"

Dieter Hildebrandt, member of the Research School on Service-oriented Systems Engineering and member of the Computer Graphics Systems working group, contributed to a Workshop on “Geoinformationen in mobile Applikationen” which was organized by BIKUM, GEOkomm, and GFZ Potsdam and was held at the GFZ on June 23, 2011. At this workshop, Dieter Hildebrandt gave a talk on “Interactive Visualization of massive 3D City Models on Lightweight Devices”.
